editorial:
Imagine being dropped into the sunny streets of Ibiza, but instead of partying, you are hunting down dangerous mercenaries. You get to follow Tate, a man who does not take any nonsense, as he goes on a rampage to avenge his friend. The vibe is gritty and loud, making you feel like you are right in the middle of a street war. It takes the best parts of the previous movies and turns the volume up to ten, giving you a story about loyalty and revenge that moves very quickly.

What really works here is the action. The fights feel real and the pacing never lets up, though some of the plot points are a bit simple. If you love tough guys and big explosions, you will have a blast. To get the full experience, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail in the fight scenes. If you are a fan of the series, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move so you can watch it whenever you want. It is a wild ride that does not try to be too fancy, just pure entertainment.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Tate tracks the lead mercenary to a hidden villa. After a brutal fight, Tate discovers that the betrayal came from someone he actually trusted within his own circle. He takes out the traitor and the rest of the crew in a massive explosion. The movie ends with Tate walking away from the fire, having finally gotten his revenge, but he is left alone with no friends left to trust.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tough-guy action movies and crime sagas.
